notes.title: Gun Fight Mode
notes.notes:
Hello all,

The wait is finally over, Deceptus is back with a new mode for players to decide once and for all on who's the best dueler. 
Introducing an all-new mode called Gun mode where players only fight with guns and pistols. 

Relive a classic western duel with your friends in the new Gun mode western. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984532/22f42a20aa2de4e629537b2ac2c7f7dad989f559.png[/img]


Or fight alongside the graves of champions, in the new Gun mode Graveyard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984532/faf7da8032cfd97b1194c1354ed01538cf26b139.png[/img]


We reimagined the maps selection screen and improved its layout for faster game and mode selection

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984532/1130e7b958d2d804ddef982c9854267146d1419b.png[/img]

Lastly, listening to our community’s feedback, we have introduced new lobby mechanics. Once the room is created all players can go back to the same room after the match and start playing again, player no longer has to recreate the same room again and again.

We are continuously working, adding, and improving the game functionalities. Your feedback is important to us. 

Happy Decepting!

notes.title: Latest Update
notes.notes:

[*] Unlocked Maps become locked again. - FIXED

[*] DLC not downloadable nor accessible from in-game Map Menu - FIXED

[*] Achievements not working on Steam - FIXED
[/olist]

[h2][b]Improvements & Features[/b][/h2]
